We believe families are the largest untapped caregiving workforce in America, and that technology can help them deliver better care while driving stronger outcomes and greater transparency across the healthcare system.

Abby Care combines clinical oversight with an AI-powered platform to train, enable, and support family caregivers in delivering high-quality care at home. Our platform helps health plans and government partners better understand, verify, and improve care in the home. We expand access to care, reduce reliance on higher-cost settings, and help ensure public dollars are spent effectively.

We are proud…

sections.title: The Opportunity:
paras: Abby Care is at an exciting inflection point; since 2022 we have grown to support family caregivers in 8 markets nationally, and we're thrilled to launch Abby Care in the greater Phoenix market and are building the founding team. Critical to our success is hiring for a founding Family Onboarding Partner to help us grow our presence and deliver on our mission - helping families find Abby Care.

As our Family Onboarding Partner, you will function as the key point of contact for our family caregivers & patients from their first call through their start of care, representing Abby Care with every touchpoint. You'll answer questions with patience, walk caregivers through intake and documentation, coordinate training, and facilitate a smooth handoff to our nursing and engagement teams. At launch you'll handle both inbound and outbound outreach, because we don't have a separate sales team. Most of your day is on the phone with people who are hopeful and doing something hard for someone they love.

A true builder, you’re energized by being part of a founding team, setting the bar for high touch, caring hospitality. Highly organized, you enjoy putting in place the processes and systems that support our caregiver’s success. You’re a people person, and can relate easily across all communities and cultures, and enjoy being the source of truth for our clients. You’re not afraid to roll up your sleeves, and want to be part of a founding team that is setting the standards for care in the market. If you’re excited to be part of a small but mighty team that is on a mission to change family caregiving in a fundamentally human centered and tech enabled capacity, we’d love to hear from you!

sections.title: What you’ll work on:
bullets: Be the One Person: Be a family's single point of contact from the first call through the start of care.
Reach Families Fast: Reach every referred family quickly, aiming for within 24 hours, by phone and text, and keep trying until you connect.
Run Intake: Walk families through intake by phone or a self-serve link. The family chooses, and you stay with them either way.
Handle the Paperwork: Chase documents, coordinate the background check, records, and forms, and keep families moving.
Coordinate Training: Keep the family caregiver on track through training, and nudge when something stalls.
Schedule the Start of Care: Schedule the visit and run the kickoff call with our engagement manager and RN, so the handoff is warm.
Keep Partners Informed: Update case managers and providers, through the case management coordinator, at the right moments.
Track Everything: Log every conversation in our CRM the same day.

sections.title: What you’ll have:
bullets: 2+ years in home care or home health intake or admissions, care coordination, or another high-touch service role.
Warmth and patience. You can handle emotional conversations and stay calm and kind.
Phone-first. You're confident on calls, and you can follow a script and know when to drop it.
Comfort with a CRM like Salesforce, and with juggling many families at once without dropping anyone.
A founding mindset: you have helped build a process or a team in the early days, and you liked it.
Spanish is a plus.

sections.title: About the Role

paras: Kroger Precision Marketing (KPM) has launched an AI Platform domain to define how AI is built, scaled, and used across internal teams and external brand-facing platforms.

This Senior Product Manager role leads a cross-functional team across Data Science and Engineering and owns the roadmap for the shared foundation that helps KPM teams build trusted agents at scale. The north star for this foundation is to reduce the time and cost of building new AI capabilities by turning common infrastructure, context, tooling, and governance into reusable platform services. This foundation is what makes a unified KPM AI experience possible — one assistant, across every platform, workflow, and team, built once and delivered everywhere.

The work spans two layers. The infrastructure layer includes enterprise agent development and deployment patterns, shared chat and notification experiences, Agent-to-Agent (A2A) interactions, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) infrastructure. The intelligence and quality layer includes context-layer capabilities, agent reasoning and evaluation, LLM observability, feedback loop design, product analytics, and governance.

sections.title: Key Responsibilities
bullets: Own the platform roadmap: translate the AI Platform vision into a clear roadmap, proactively define plans to move the work forward, and sequence foundational capabilities based on customer needs, business value, technical readiness, risk, cost, and reuse potential

Scale reusable AI foundations: own shared agent infrastructure, context-layer capabilities, deployment patterns, tooling, and standards that help teams build new AI capabilities faster without duplicating platform wiring
Know your builders: partner with product and agent builders to understand how they work, where they are blocked, and what shared capabilities would unlock the most value across the portfolio

Pick the right bets: identify the highest-leverage platform investments, make explicit tradeoffs, and focus the team on the capabilities that unlock the most reuse, adoption, and downstream product impact

Lead with market-informed judgment: stay current on AI trends, vendors, and competitor moves; form a clear point of view; seek input early; and adjust quickly when evidence points to a better approach
Ship with momentum: drive delivery with Agile Delivery, Data Science, and Engineering by managing scope, dependencies, risks, tradeoffs, and timelines

Drive adoption, quality, and impact: define rollout plans, success measures, agent quality evaluations, observability signals, and feedback loops that improve reliability, adoption, and business impact

Enable the organization: educate teams on the platform, how to use it, and where it is going; rally stakeholders around the shared vision; and create the forums, documentation, and lightweight processes that help builders adopt the platform consistently

sections.title: Minimum Qualifications
bullets: Product management: 3–5 years of product management experience

GenAI product delivery and quality: strong understanding of how LLM-powered and agentic products move from prototype to production, including prompt and context design, RAG, orchestration, tool integration, evaluation frameworks, LLM observability, feedback loops, governance, and rollout
Platform and builder mindset: experience building shared platforms, internal developer tools, or reusable capabilities where product and engineering teams are the primary customers
Stakeholder intake and roadmap tradeoffs: experience gathering needs from multiple stakeholders, reconciling competing priorities, and sequencing shared platform work under resource constraints
Technical fluency: background in engineering, data science, analytics, or a highly technical product area, with the ability to go deep on architecture and delivery tradeoffs
Communication: ability to translate technical complexity into clear decisions, tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations for business and technical audiences
Leadership: a humble, direct leadership style, comfortable saying “I don’t know,” and confident leading toward an answer
Operating judgment: ability to move quickly while respecting security, governance, and enterprise delivery standards

greenhouse:andurilindustries:5254920007.summary: Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

sections.title: ABOUT THE TEAM
paras: The Mission Command team is part of the Connected Warfare Division. We build the command and control (C2) tools that help warfighters understand what is happening around them, make faster decisions, and direct their forces. We spend a lot of our time with the people who actually use these tools: in the field, during exercises, wherever they are.

sections.title: ABOUT THE ROLE
paras:
This is not a product manager who happens to spend some time forward. The forward work is the product work. As a Forward Deployed Product Manager, you own the path from a warfighter problem to a fielded solution. That covers applications, data models, user experiences, integrations, and infrastructure.

Most of all, you work as a translation layer between the warfighter and the engineering teams. You embed with units, build real expertise in how they fight, and earn enough trust that influence runs both ways. You are there to solve their problems, not to sell them something, and you build an open, trusting relationship by doing exactly that. Sometimes an introduction is made for you. You have to be comfortable with walking into a unit that has never heard of Lattice, and earn your footing from the bottom up.

The profile we are hiring for: a product manager who can walk into a formation, understand the fight, earn the trust of the people in it, map the workflow and the data underneath it, and then pull the right parts of Anduril together to solve it. You walk in with a strong sense of ownership and responsibility, but you back it up with real curiosity and humility.

sections.title: WHAT YOU'LL DO
bullets: Own warfighter outcomes, not features. Embed with units, learn the mission, find the problems that matter most, and own them through development, fielding, and the work that comes after.

Build real relationships with the people in the fight. Earn the trust of warfighters, commanders, staff, and subject matter experts. Become a partner who understands how the unit actually fights, not just what shows up in a requirements document.
Do the research in the field. Learn by watching, asking questions, and taking part in real workflows. Turn what you learn into clear priorities.
Connect the fight to the product. Map the users, decisions, workflows, systems, data, and dependencies behind an outcome, and use that to drive what gets built and integrated.

Design across the whole stack. Do not default to a new app or a new screen. Work out whether an outcome needs an application change, a new or richer data model, an integration, a workflow that spans applications, or a change in how data moves across the Mesh.
Use the data model as a product tool. Get to know what data exists, how it is represented, where it comes from, who uses it, and what has to change to make a workflow possible.

Design for the tactical edge. Understand how the network and the hardware affect what the user sees and does. Account for degraded conditions, bandwidth, latency, and compute when you define a solution.
Pull the right people together. Get warfighters, engineering, design, and the other teams around the same problem, and drive them toward one coherent answer.

sections.title: WHO YOU ARE
paras: Anduril moves fast and is scaling fast. We value ambition, hard work, a high bar, and a willingness to disrupt how things are normally done. The people who do well here tend to show these traits:
bullets: Bias for Action. You ask for forgiveness, not permission, and you hate waiting around to be told what to do.
Outcome-Oriented. You figure out what the business needs and work backward from there.
Customer Focused. You have real empathy for users and build things they actually want to use.
Dive Deep. You sweat the details and get into the weeds to find the root cause of a problem.
Ownership. You care about your products and about everything the business depends on them for. You hold yourself accountable for what your systems do and for what they fail to do.
Agility. You change direction without drama when the priorities change.
First Principles Thinking. You solve problems based on what is actually best here, not because a vendor recommended it or because it is how your last company did it.

sections.title: The Role
paras: Appfire is looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager who can turn customer problems, product capabilities, and market opportunities into compelling go-to-market strategies that drive measurable business results.

This is a highly cross-functional and hands-on role. You will own positioning, messaging, go-to-market strategy, product launches, sales enablement, and full-funnel content for a portfolio of B2B SaaS products.

A critical part of this role is translating product strategy into top-, middle-, and bottom-of-funnel marketing programs and content that generate demand, educate prospects, accelerate buying decisions, and create expansion opportunities with existing Appfire customers and app users. You should be equally comfortable developing the strategic narrative for a new SaaS product and turning that narrative into the campaigns, assets, sales plays, and customer journeys needed to take it to market.

sections.title: Positioning, Messaging & Market Strategy
bullets: Develop differentiated positioning, messaging, value propositions, and market narratives grounded in customer needs, competitive dynamics, and product capabilities.
Translate complex SaaS products and technical capabilities into clear, compelling stories for business, technical, and executive audiences.

Define and continuously refine ideal customer profiles, personas, use cases, buying triggers, pain points, and customer journeys using customer research, competitive intelligence, win/loss insights, product usage signals, Sales feedback, and market data.

Navigate a complex, multi-product portfolio with overlapping personas, use cases, and customer needs, creating clear product, solution, and portfolio-level positioning that helps customers understand how individual offerings fit together.

Identify opportunities to move beyond product-by-product marketing by connecting related products to broader customer problems, workflows, and solution narratives—while maintaining clear differentiation between offerings.

Build messaging frameworks that can be consistently activated across campaigns, digital experiences, sales conversations, partner motions, and customer communications, ensuring the right product, solution, or portfolio story reaches each audience throughout the buying journey.

sections.title: Full-Funnel Demand & Content
bullets: Partner closely with Demand Generation and Content teams to develop top-, middle-, and bottom-of-funnel strategies and content that create demand, capture interest, nurture prospects, and accelerate pipeline.

Translate positioning and messaging into high-performing assets such as campaign concepts, landing pages, solution content, webinars, customer stories, comparison content, product videos, nurture programs, sales plays, and conversion-focused content.
Develop targeted programs for both net-new prospects and existing Appfire customers and app users , including cross-sell, upsell, adoption, and expansion opportunities.
Understand how content should evolve throughout the buyer journey—from creating awareness of a customer problem to helping a buyer evaluate alternatives and ultimately make a purchasing decision.
Partner with Growth and Demand Generation teams to test messaging, offers, audiences, and content and use performance data to continuously improve conversion and pipeline impact.
Connect PMM activity to measurable outcomes including engagement, lead generation, pipeline creation, trial activity, product adoption, conversion, cross-sell, and revenue.

sections.title: Product Launches & Go-to-Market
bullets: Lead end-to-end go-to-market strategy and execution for new SaaS products, major product launches, new editions, and strategic product capabilities.
Define target audiences, customer problems, positioning, messaging, launch tiers, channels, success criteria, and GTM plans.
Coordinate cross-functional launch execution across Product, Sales, Demand Generation, Customer Success, Channel/Partners, and Marketing.
Develop launch assets spanning the full customer journey—from market awareness and demand creation through evaluation, trial, purchase, onboarding, adoption, and expansion.
Establish measurable launch objectives and use customer and performance data to evaluate results and optimize post-launch programs.
Balance major launches with ongoing GTM programs that sustain demand and adoption after launch.

greenhouse:boulevard:4726990006.summary:
Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most.

Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen .

sections.title: Who is Boulevard?
paras: We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most .

sections.title: Come do the best work of your life at Boulevard.
paras: As our Senior Solutions Engineer, you'll own the technical story in our enterprise and strategic sales cycles. You'll take how a multi-location salon, spa, medspa, or franchise actually operates and turn it into a credible, tailored demonstration of Boulevard. This is a senior individual contributor role with real autonomy, no prescribed playbook, and the chance to build assets that raise the technical quality of our whole go-to-market team.

You'll work closely with our Enterprise and Mid-Market Account Executives, Product, Engineering, and Implementation. We're building the operating system for beauty and wellness, and here the line between your work and its impact is never abstract. This role is remote within the U.S.

sections.title: What you’ll do here
bullets: Lead technical discovery, technical qualification, integration solution design, and executive-facing readouts on enterprise and strategic opportunities.
Partner with Account Executives to connect Boulevard to each prospect's business case, showing value, ROI, and how our APIs extend across their existing technology stack.
Build working proofs of concept and interactive prototypes that show prospects their own workflows running on Boulevard.
Write RFP and security questionnaire responses that give prospects usable insight into their own operations.
Advise prospects and internal teams on security configuration and on HIPAA, PHI, and PII handling, and serve as the technical contact for security review during procurement.

Scope integration requirements and sort each one into fits today, partner solution, or genuine product gap, then document them for Sales, Implementation, and Support. Turn recurring gaps and feature requests from live deals into clear signal for Product and Engineering.
Advise on demo environment strategy, create sandboxes (most often post-sale migration sandboxes), and prepare prospect briefings so what we promise in the sales cycle is what we deliver.

Technical fluency in APIs, integrations, data flows, and permissions models, and credibility with both operators and technical stakeholders without engineering support for routine questions.
Strong written communication and the ability to produce precise documentation that stands on its own.
Proven ability to operate independently in ambiguity, define the approach, and own the outcome.
A degree is not required.

Braeburn Job Scam Warning

At Braeburn, we prioritize the security of your personal information. Be aware of individuals falsely presenting themselves as Braeburn employees or representatives to gain access to your personal information or money through fictitious job offers.

greenhouse:mongodb:8327081.summary:
MongoDB is seeking an experienced and outcome-oriented Product Manager to partner with the Product Lead for Source-to-Pay (S2P) and Travel & Expense (T&E) to deliver the roadmap across these domains. This role sits at the intersection of Finance, Procurement, Accounting, employees, and Technology, helping MongoDB scale spend-management operations through intuitive experiences, reliable platforms, strong controls, and intelligent automation.

You will own product discovery, strategy, roadmap, prioritization, requirements, delivery partnership, and adoption for a portfolio that may include procurement, supplier onboarding and management, purchasing, invoicing, business travel, corporate cards, expense submission, audit, reimbursement, and related reporting and integrations.

Build deep understanding of users and business processes across Procurement, Accounts Payable, Accounting, Travel & Expense, Finance, Legal, Security, Internal Audit, and employees
Translate business problems into clear product outcomes, including detailed PRDs, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, process designs, and release plans
Lead discovery through interviews, workflow analysis, data analysis, process mapping, and collaboration with subject-matter experts
Prioritize investments across new capabilities, enhancements, integrations, operational improvements, technical debt, compliance needs, and user experience
Partner closely with Engineering, Architecture, Business Systems, Data & Analytics, Security, Compliance, Internal Audit, and external vendors to deliver reliable and maintainable solutions

Drive improvements across procurement and spend workflows, including requisitions, approvals, supplier onboarding, supplier data, purchase orders, invoicing, payment-related handoffs, and spend visibility

Drive improvements across T&E workflows, including travel booking, expense submission, corporate cards, policy enforcement, audit, approvals, reimbursement, employee communications, and support experiences

5+ years of product management experience, or equivalent experience in enterprise technology, business systems, product ownership, or solution delivery
Proven experience owning an enterprise product or set of connected tools from discovery through delivery and adoption
Experience with Source-to-Pay, procurement, accounts payable, travel, expense, corporate card, or related Finance operations
Strong understanding of enterprise business-system concepts, including workflows, approvals, master data, integrations, reporting, controls, and role-based access
Experience partnering with Agile or iterative delivery teams and translating complex business needs into actionable requirements
Strong analytical skills and the ability to use data to frame problems, prioritize work, and measure outcomes
Demonstrated AI fluency: understand the strengths, limitations, risks, and economics of modern AI capabilities, and know how to translate them into responsible enterprise product opportunities

Demonstrate measurable progress against agreed product outcomes and service-level indicators
Strengthen platform reliability, integration quality, auditability, and operational readiness
Become a trusted product partner to Finance and Technology leaders and a recognized subject-matter expert for the assigned domain

Operational ownership: Care about reliability, controls, supportability, change management, and the experience after launch

greenhouse:motus:8023518.summary:
Motus is the complete solution for managing employee driving, built for smarter personal vehicle use. With more than 90 years of proven expertise, Motus brings together reimbursement, risk mitigation, and advanced analytics into one platform that helps organizations maximize field team productivity, optimize vehicle spend, and reduce corporate risk exposure. sections.title: From the job description
paras: As Senior Product Marketing Manager, you'll drive product positioning, go-to-market strategy, and adoption for our flagship Motus Reimburse and Motus Protect solutions. You'll translate consumer, competitor, and marketplace insights into differentiated messaging, competitive strategies, and value propositions that influence product direction and drive business growth.

You'll partner closely with Product, Sales, Customer Success, GTM Enablement, and Marketing to influence product direction, inform roadmap decisions, and carry out high-impact go-to-market programs that accelerate adoption, retention, and revenue growth. As a modern product marketer, you'll embrace AI, automation, and groundbreaking technologies as force multipliers. You will find new ways to accelerate research, improve decision-making, and scale the impact of product marketing across the organization.
This role reports to the Vice President of Product Marketing.

If you're excited to influence product and go-to-market strategy, unlock new growth opportunities, leverage emerging technologies to amplify your impact, and tell compelling customer-centric stories, we'd love to talk with you.
bullets: Own go-to-market strategy and execution for assigned product offerings, driving adoption, retention, expansion, and revenue growth through product launches, sales enablement, customer advocacy, and coordinated cross-functional execution.

Influence product roadmap priorities, go-to-market strategy, and investment decisions through customer, competitive, and market insights. Partner with Product, Sales, and Customer Success leaders to define success metrics, measure performance, and drive measurable business outcomes.

Develop differentiated positioning, messaging, and value propositions that increase market awareness, strengthen competitive differentiation, improve conversion, and drive customer acquisition, retention, and expansion. Reinforce Motus's market position through compelling customer stories, data, and proof points.

Leverage AI, automation, and emerging technologies to build scalable approaches to market intelligence, competitive strategy, content creation, and go-to-market execution that increase team effectiveness and accelerate business outcomes.
Influence and align stakeholders across Product, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Enablement to accelerate execution, remove barriers to growth, and deliver exceptional customer experiences.

Communicate market opportunities, business risks, performance insights, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership, enabling informed investment decisions and organizational alignment on growth priorities.
6+ years of experience in product marketing, marketing, consulting, or business strategy roles, preferably supporting B2B SaaS products and enterprise buyers.
Experience developing customer, market, and competitive insights that influence product strategy, positioning, roadmap decisions, and go-to-market execution.

greenhouse:nebius:4944822101.summary:
Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. greenhouse:newsbreak:4722464006.summary:
Local life runs on local information. What happened down the street? Who can fix this? Where should we go tonight? NewsBreak started in 2015 to answer these questions, and today more than 40 million people a month rely on us to follow what’s going on in their zip code.

Three platforms with one vision: powering local life. Led by founder and CEO Jeff Zheng, NewsBreak is our local life and news platform; Nearby AI connects people with local businesses; and NDot AI helps publishers and creators grow and earn.

Building for the long term. A $115 million Series C made us a unicorn in 2021, and we keep investing in our people. We’re Great Place to Work® certified and named to Fast Company ’s Best Workplaces for Innovators (2025) and Fortune ’s Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™ (2026).

Strong analytics: funnels, cohorts and retention in Amplitude or similar; basic SQL preferred

Build the measurement foundations that make optimization reliable, including attribution, event and label quality, calibration, reporting, and privacy-constrained signals.
Turn complex optimization capabilities into intuitive advertiser products, including auto-bidding and other automation that improves outcomes and simplifies campaign management.

bullets: 12+ years of product management experience, including significant experience in advertising technology, marketplace optimization, or ML-driven ranking and delivery systems.

Strong technical fluency and experience partnering with Engineering, Machine Learning, and Data Science on models, experimentation, calibration, serving systems, and platform architecture.
Strong product judgment and experience balancing advertiser outcomes, revenue, delivery, measurement quality, and user experience when data or signals are imperfect.

A spinoff out of MIT, Tulip is headquartered in Somerville, MA, with offices in Germany, Hungary, Singapore, Israel and Japan. Tulip has been recognized as a World Economic Forum Global Innovator, a 2024 Deloitte Technology Fast award winner, one of Energage's Top Workplaces USA, and…

sections.title: About You:

You coach by doing, give people real ownership, and stay close enough to customers to know when something's off. You're at home on a plant floor and in front of executives. And you're always looking for a smarter way to deliver.

sections.title: What skills do I need?

Experience delivering customer projects within scope, on time, and on budget
Strong communication skills with customers and internal teams, from frontline operators to executives
Nice to have: experience in regulated industries like Life Sciences or Aerospace & Defense

sections.title: Key Responsibilities:

Turn lessons from customer implementations into reusable content and playbooks that make every project faster.

greenhouse:verkada:5252633007.summary:
Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

sections.title: Who We Are
paras: You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: Verkada's Connectivity products secure people and property in remote and edge environments. Our Cellular and Wi-Fi Gateways bring Verkada's full platform including threat detection, deterrence, and real-time visibility, anywhere it's needed. Verkada Gateways enable cameras, intercoms, access control, and sensors to be deployed in locations without stable internet or power.

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to own and grow Verkada's Gateway product line. In this role, your mission is twofold: make gateways the enabling layer that unlocks every unwired Verkada deployment, and build the product depth and business model that grows Gateway into a flagship product.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Own strategy and execution for Verkada's Gateway product line
Own and expand the gateway roadmap across reliability, fleet-scale cloud management, and new connectivity options and form factors.
Partner with product lines across Verkada (remote cameras, security trailers, transportation, intercoms, access) to deliver connectivity-as-a-service and drive ecosystem attach
Define data plan and pricing strategy that improves both customer adoption and Verkada margin

sections.title: What You Bring
bullets: 5+ years of experience in product management, preferably in B2B networking, connectivity, embedded systems, or IoT
Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or similar quantitative field. MS, PhD, or MBA optional
Proven history of launching and scaling products and businesses. Strong customer intuition, technical depth, and ability to navigate tradeoffs are critical to success in this role.
Strong understanding of networking fundamentals (LTE/5G, Wi-Fi, WAN failover, SIM/carrier management), plus foundational knowledge of firmware, device bring-up, and hardware design
Ability to build platform and recurring-revenue business models, with a structured approach to ambiguous problems like data plan pricing, carrier economics, attach-rate modeling, and ROI analysis

Excited to roll up your sleeves and get out of the office. You'll spend time with installers, integrators, and customers deploying in unwired environments. You’ll use that insight to shape the product

greenhouse:veterinaryemergencygroupst:61.summary:
In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

sections.title: ABOUT VEG
paras: This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.
VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

sections.title: THE JOB
paras: As a Customer Experience Coordinator, your job is to define the customer’s experience through service, focus, and participation—so, you are passionate about perfecting the experience before, during, and after their time at VEG. Outgoing and personable, with each customer, you conduct yourself professionally in both demeanor and presence. You find ways to say yes and put patient and customer experience above all else. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to grow where you want to go, building valuable experience and paving the way for your career to take unexpected and rewarding directions.

sections.title: WHAT YOU’LL DO
bullets: Greet every customer with warmth and urgency, whether in person, over the phone, or online
Oversee all customer communications (calls, emails, texts), record details accurately, and route urgent medical calls to a doctor quickly
Deliver personalized, memorable experiences—always looking for creative ways to say “yes” to customer needs
Listen with empathy, resolve concerns quickly, and anticipate issues before they escalate
Keep nursing team and doctors updated on customer needs for a seamless care experience.
Provide confidential, compassionate guidance on financial options and end-of-life decisions
Process payments accurately while protecting personal and financial information
Follow up with customers after visits to check on their pet’s care and strengthen relationships

sections.title: WHAT YOU NEED
bullets: 2+ years of experience in a customer service role
Advanced knowledge in computer programs and practice management software
Highly organized, with strong attention to detail
A strong communicator; able to interact positively with anyone and everyone
A strong multitasker, able to thrive amid chaos
High emotional intelligence, able to read a room and plan and act accordingly
Adaptable and amenable in high stakes environments
Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

greenhouse:vts:4723555005.summary: As we continue to revolutionize the commercial real estate industry, we're hiring an Associate Implementation Manager to join our team. This is a role built for someone ready to take things on and grow fast. You'll be embedded in a fast-moving implementation org, supporting clients and internal teams through onboarding, approval, and early adoption. You'll work cross-functionally to ensure a seamless experience from pre-sale through ongoing support, and you'll do it with an AI-first mindset , leaning on modern tools to work smarter, not harder.

sections.title: What Success Looks Like
paras: First 6 months: You've shadowed senior IMs across the full implementation lifecycle, taken ownership of data onboarding for at least one client, and built or contributed to at least one AI-driven workflow that saves the team measurable time.

First 12 months: You're running smaller client implementations independently, facilitating client meetings without a senior IM, and recognized cross-functionally as the go-to for at least one part of the implementation process.

What VTS Values & How We Show It
bullets: Strive for Excellence - We know your potential is unlimited. Take advantage of our executive coaches and our training and career development programs available to all employees!

Be Customer Obsessed - We’re employee obsessed too! VTS offers competitive compensation, comprehensive health benefits (including dental and vision), pre-tax commuter benefits, and a 401(k) plan. Not to mention the fun stuff - quarterly happy hours, wellness events, clubs, and team lunches!
Be Curious - Benefit from a culture that promotes new learning. VTS offers an education stipend to all employees!
Move as One - We work in an open floor plan to promote cross-functional collaboration.
Take Ownership - Be an owner of the company you’re building with our equity packages.
Appreciate the Difference - VTS embraces and celebrates diversity. We understand the importance of a strong work-life balance. We offer a flexible PTO policy, generous family leave program, and more!

sections.title: ABOUT VTS
paras:
VTS is the only AI-driven technology platform enabling intelligent real estate by unifying industry professionals, investors, and their customers at scale. In 2013, VTS revolutionized commercial real estate leasing operations with what is now VTS Lease. Today, VTS AI is the largest first-party insights and collaboration engine in the industry, transforming how strategic decisions are made and executed by the real estate industry globally.

With the VTS Platform, consisting of VTS Lease , VTS Market , VTS Activate , and VTS Data , every stakeholder in real estate is given real-time market information and workflow tools to do their job with unparalleled speed and intelligence. VTS is the global leader, with more than 60% of Class A office space in the U.S., and 13 billion square feet of office, residential, retail, and industrial space is managed through the platform worldwide. VTS is utilized by over 45,000 professionals and over 1.2 million total users each day, including industry-leading customers such as Blackstone, Brookfield Properties, LaSalle Investment Management, Hines, BXP, Oxford Properties, JLL, and CBRE.

VTS maintains offices in New York City, London, Toronto, Chicago.
To learn more about VTS and view our open roles, visit us at vts.com or follow us on Instagram (@WeAreVTS) or LinkedIn.

greenhouse:wolt:8392867.summary:
At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

sections.title: About Wolt
paras: Wolt is part of DoorDash, alongside Deliveroo. Together, we’re improving how people and businesses connect through local commerce. While this role is based in Zagreb, you’ll be part of an organisation that learns and grows across countries and brands.

We’re looking for an Operations Associate to join our Courier Onboarding team in Zagreb. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you’ll help us turn more courier applicants into active couriers in Croatia, and make sure our cities have the couriers they need.
Our Courier Onboarding team shapes a courier’s first experience with Wolt. We improve how applicants move from application to first delivery, and make sure couriers are ready to succeed from day one.

sections.title: What you’ll be doing
paras: You’ll be joining the Courier Onboarding team, which works across Croatia and neighbouring countries. Your focus will be Croatia, and you’ll work closely with colleagues in the region. Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:
bullets: Own the onboarding funnel in Croatia, from application to first delivery, finding where applicants drop off and driving the changes that improve conversion
Monitor courier supply across Croatian cities, spot gaps early and lead local actions that keep deliveries running smoothly
Turn data into clear recommendations, backing your decisions with evidence rather than assumptions
Improve processes and workflows, and help roll out new onboarding tools, so that onboarding can scale without extra manual work
Keep onboarding guidelines, training materials and FAQs clear and up to date, so couriers are ready for their first delivery
Work with CRM, Supply, Fleet and regional Operations teams to align onboarding work with wider business goals and campaigns

sections.title: What you’ll need to thrive
bullets: Relevant experience in operations, process management or a similar field, with demonstrated ownership of a process or set of numbers that you improved in a measurable way
Strong analytical skills: you use data, for example in Excel, Google Sheets or BI tools, to understand how a process performs and to support your decisions
Proven ability to work with colleagues and teams you do not manage, and to get things moving without formal authority
Clear written and spoken communication, including turning complex steps into simple instructions
A solution-oriented approach: you take initiative and make decisions with little oversight
Native-level Croatian and fluent English, as you’ll work with colleagues across the region

sections.title: Our humble expectations
paras: You’ll have ownership of an important part of how Wolt grows in Croatia, with room to use your judgement and see what your decisions change. The work is varied: one day a funnel analysis, the next a conversation with colleagues about a city that is short of couriers. You’ll learn from teams across the region and see the results of your work quickly. As part of DoorDash, you’ll have the backing of a global business, with the scale and resources to help you do your best work.

XO Health believes healthcare is fixable. Become part of the community changing the face of the industry.

XO Health is the first health plan designed by and for self-insured employers that delivers a more unified health experience for everyone – from those who receive care, to those who deliver it, to those who pay for it.

We are growing a multi-disciplinary team of diverse and digitally empowered employees ready to rebuild trust in healthcare through comprehensive and unified transformation.

sections.title: About XO Health
paras: Headquartered in Alpharetta, GA, and founded in 2022, XO Health Inc. is the first health plan designed by and for self-insured employers that delivers a more unified health experience for everyone—from those who receive care, to those who deliver it, to those who pay for it.
We are growing a multi-disciplinary team of diverse and digitally empowered employees who are ready to rebuild trust in healthcare through comprehensive and unified transformation.

sections.title: Position Overview
paras: The Client Account Manager is responsible for the day-to-day management and overall client experience for assigned XO Health employer clients. This role serves as a primary point of contact for clients, ensuring timely communication, issue resolution, effective execution of client requests, and successful delivery of ongoing services and commitments.

The Client Account Manager will develop strong working relationships with employer clients and their key stakeholders. The role will collaborate closely with internal XO Health teams and external partners to address issues, coordinate activities, deliver reporting, and execute client initiatives.

This is a highly collaborative, hands-on role that requires strong judgment, organization, communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced startup environment. The ideal candidate brings a strong understanding of self-funded employer health benefits and is comfortable taking ownership, navigating ambiguity, identifying solutions, and stepping outside of traditional role boundaries when needed to support the client and the business.

sections.title: Client Relationship Management
bullets: Serve as the primary day-to-day point of contact for assigned employer clients.
Develop and maintain strong, trusted relationships with clients and key stakeholders.
Ensure client questions, requests, and concerns are acknowledged, coordinated, and resolved in a timely manner.
Own client issues through resolution by partnering closely with Network, Operations, Member Experience, Claims, Clinical, Technology, Finance, Sales, and other XO Health teams to support client needs
Proactively communicate status, risks, issues, and opportunities to clients and internal leadership.
Facilitate regular client meetings and ensure appropriate follow-up and accountability.
Lead and participate in client Open Enrollment meetings and activities.
Prepare and deliver recurring client reporting packages, presentations, and operational updates.

sections.title: Project Management
bullets: Lead client-specific projects and initiatives as requested by the client or XO Health leadership.
Develop project plans, timelines, deliverables, and communication strategies.
Coordinate cross-functional resources and maintain accountability for project milestones.
Facilitate project meetings and provide regular status updates.
Ensure successful transition of completed projects into ongoing operational processes.

greenhouse:zocdoc:8360585.summary:
You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.

We’re here to give power to the patient.

For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.

Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from seeking to getting . We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.

sections.title: Our Mission
paras: Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

sections.title: Your Impact on our Mission
paras: Healthcare should work for patients - but it doesn't. Instead of easy access, patients face outdated insurance directories, long phone holds, weekslong wait times, and surprise bills. In any other industry, this experience would be unacceptable. But in healthcare, patients lack market power and are expected to tolerate broken systems. Zocdoc's mission is to give power back to the patient. We've built the leading healthcare marketplace, helping people find and book care across 50 states, 200+ specialties, and 12,000+ insurance plans. By giving patients choice and visibility, we enable a system where providers compete for patients - not the other way around.

Zocdoc now brings on entire health systems and practice groups at once, connecting tens of thousands of providers through automated pipelines. At that scale, the hard part is keeping every provider accurate and every booking intact as rosters change, schedules shift and data arrives that no one has seen before. As a Senior Product Manager on the Provider team, you'll own that problem. You'll build the products that make our provider network self-correcting: problems are caught before a patient or practice notices, most are fixed automatically, and every decision makes the next one faster. You'll also make sure Zocdoc reflects how each practice actually wants to work, so practices can trust every booking they get. You'll shape how people and AI agents work together to run the network as it grows many times over, and you'll make sure that when a patient books on Zocdoc, the appointment is real. If you're excited to do that alongside deeply thoughtful, driven, and collaborative teammates, we'd love to meet you.

sections.title: You'll enjoy this role if you are…
bullets: Personally motivated by improving our healthcare system
Drawn to high-leverage problems, where getting it right lets the whole business scale
Excited to build products where people and AI agents work side by side, and to earn the trust that requires
Someone who thinks in systems and goes after root causes
A first-principles thinker who thrives in ambiguity and can always find the crawl/walk/run path
Comfortable owning an outcome end to end, from the strategy to the metric that proves it worked

sections.title: Your day to day is…
bullets: Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for keeping provider data and bookings accurate as Zocdoc scales
Set the goals that define success, get them instrumented, and report progress to leadership
Own how practices tell Zocdoc the way they want to work, and make sure Zocdoc keeps reflecting it as practices grow and change

sections.title: Key Responsibilities:
paras: Including, but not limited to, the following:
bullets: New Business Development – Lead proactive business development efforts across assigned accounts and priority prospects, identifying, qualifying, and converting opportunities for consulting, analytics, and primary market research engagements.
Account Growth – Develop and execute account plans for key clients, driving expansion through cross-selling, upselling, and identification of emerging client needs.
Strategic Selling – Lead consultative sales discussions with senior pharmaceutical and biotechnology stakeholders, aligning MAC capabilities to client business objectives and commercial challenges.

Opportunity Ownership – Own the end-to-end sales process from opportunity identification through proposal development, contract negotiation, close and oversee execution through strong collaboration with Consulting team.

Client Relationship Development – Build and maintain strong relationships with decision-makers and influencers across commercial, market access, medical affairs, clinical development, insights, analytics, and corporate strategy functions.
Commercial Collaboration – Partner with consulting, research, and analytics teams to develop compelling, differentiated solutions that address client needs and support successful proposal conversion.
Pipeline Management – Develop and maintain a robust pipeline of qualified opportunities, ensuring accurate forecasting and achievement of individual bookings and revenue goals.
Market Intelligence – Monitor industry trends, competitive activity, and emerging client priorities to identify new business opportunities and inform client conversations.

sections.title: Qualifications
bullets: Bachelor's degree required; MBA or advanced degree in business, healthcare, life sciences, or a related field preferred.
10+ years of business development, account management, or consultative sales experience within healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, market research, analytics, or consulting.
Demonstrated track record of consistently achieving or exceeding individual revenue targets.
Proven success selling complex consulting, market research, analytics, or strategic solutions to pharmaceutical and biotechnology organizations.
Experience developing relationships with senior commercial, marketing, medical, market access, clinical, insights, and business strategy stakeholders.
Experience managing multiple opportunities simultaneously within a long sales-cycle environment.
Deep understanding of the primary market research, analytics, and consulting service landscape in life sciences.
Strong strategic and consultative selling skills, with the ability to shape and win complex, multi-service engagements.

smartrecruiters:servicenow:7440001544713.summary:
We’re building Tool Studio, the best platform for developers to build AI agents and connect them to our AI Assistant.

As a product manager for Tool Studio, you’ll be on the bleeding edge of shaping how enterprises build agentic AI experiences. You’ll be designing products for developers to use, and ensure that their end-user experiences set a high bar for enterprise agents. Build on our platform and enable other ServiceNow teams to create custom applications and products using our harness. Partner closely with customers using ToolSmith, the catalog interpreter, and our developer tools; help them build successful solutions; and translate their feedback into better products.

sections.title: Job Description
bullets: You will drive product development for this product area from concept to launch with successful iteration in a fast-paced customer obsessed organization with an emphasis on written communication to convey product concepts and updates
You will create product specs to crisply identify problems, set goals, and define success metrics to help design and engineering teams develop products
You'll lead the definition & design of core technologies, developer interfaces, and end-user experiences for our agent platform.
You’ll annotate other developer platforms to build internal alignment and conviction on what good looks like.
You’ll partner closely with machine learning and platform engineers to understand the latest research papers in Agentic AI and form product recommendations based on your understanding of the market.
You’ll also play a strong role in shaping our developer ecosystem: contributing to running hackathons and growing our digital community.
You will deconstruct complex problems by utilizing your technical depth and a data-influenced approach including a steady data diet of product usage to inform roadmap
You will support cross functional teams to achieve their goals through collaborative goal setting, project definition, and milestone development throughout the project

sections.title: Qualifications
paras: For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $166,500 - $291,400 , plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs. Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location.
bullets: You are an expert in deconstructing complex problems, annotating & understanding patterns, and taking a data-driven approach to finding solutions.
You are a strong writer who can consistently write clearly and concisely about new product concepts, operations, and plans.
You are someone deeply curious and a fast learner – eager to understand the technology behind new products, conduct your own academic & competitive research.
You have strong familiarity with APIs, authentication, and integrations.
You are have experience building enterprise products that required 3rd party platform integrations
You have a proven track record of taking ownership of product goals and delivering against them
You have sound framework for when to iterate, when to discard, and when to scale products
You have the skills needed to take input from multiple sources, crystallize clear priorities, and communicate them effectively.

smartrecruiters:versant3:744000156706809.summary:
Versant is seeking a strategic, analytically strong leader to serve as Sr. Manager, Value Realization within the Enterprise Transformation Office. This role will help shape how transformation value is defined, measured, and managed across the company.

Sitting at the intersection of enterprise strategy, financial discipline, and operational execution, this leader will help translate transformation activity into clear business outcomes, credible value cases, and measurable results. The role will partner across business, finance, transformation, and technology teams to ensure enterprise initiatives are grounded in sound assumptions, aligned to priorities, and tracked with the rigor needed to support leadership decision-making.

sections.title: Job Description
paras: The ideal candidate brings a blend of financial acumen, strategic thinking, analytical rigor, and cross-functional execution. This person will play a key role in helping Versant move beyond opportunity identification and toward disciplined value realization across enterprise initiatives.

sections.title: Value Strategy, Governance & Business Case Development
bullets: Help define and evolve Versant’s value realization approach across enterprise transformation initiatives
Build and maintain frameworks for how value is identified, sized, governed, and tracked across programs and workstreams
Develop and support business cases, assumptions, and benefits models tied to priority initiatives
Help create clear standards for defining directional, committed, realized, and reinvested value
Support prioritization and sequencing decisions by helping leaders understand relative value, feasibility, timing, and dependencies
Pressure-test value assumptions and identify where additional validation, tradeoffs, or adjustments are required

sections.title: Cross-Functional Partnership & Accountability
bullets: Partner closely with Finance, business leaders, and initiative owners to validate assumptions, outcomes, and realized impact
Help connect value across multiple transformation levers, including operating model changes, process optimization, global delivery, AI/automation, and third-party spend
Strengthen accountability by linking initiative execution to measurable business results
Support leadership discussions around tradeoffs, prioritization, sequencing, and value capture
Help reinforce an enterprise discipline around delivering committed value, not just identifying opportunity

sections.title: Qualifications
bullets: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in Finance, Business, Operations, Strategy, or a related field
7+ years of experience in value realization, FP&A, transformation finance, strategic operations, consulting, program leadership, or related roles
Strong analytical and modeling skills, with the ability to interpret complex financial and operational data
Experience building business cases, benefits frameworks, and executive reporting
Experience supporting cross-functional transformation, operating model, or portfolio initiatives at the enterprise level
Ability to translate program activity and operational change into practical business and financial implications
Strong strategic thinking paired with a bias for execution and follow-through
Strong communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional partnership skills
